verdict.rationale: The evidence shows the building blocks of a SOC 2 program. These are a Policy Center and Create Policy API, a Controls catalog, Audits, automated evidence collection via integrations, and continuous monitoring tests. A community thread also ties Drata to obtaining a SOC 2 attestation. However, no cited item explicitly documents a built-in SOC 2 framework, Trust Services Criteria control mappings, or separate Type I and Type II workflows. Missing for 10: explicit SOC 2 framework documentation, TSC control mapping, Type I vs Type II audit support, built-in evidence-request workflows with auditors, independent hands-on corroboration.
